questions.q: Sterling silver is $92.5\%$ pure silver. How many grams of sterling silver must be mixed to a $90\%$ silver alloy to obtain a 500 gm of a $91\%$ of silver alloy?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: JSM / Deviation (Alligation)]

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, do chizen mix karke teesri ban rahi hai, toh bina soche Alligation fek ke maar! $90$ aur $92.5$ ke beech $91$ hai, ratio inverse aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Alligation laga:
Sterling ($92.5\%$) ...... Other ($90\%$)
............... $91\%$ ...............
$(91-90) = 1$ ...... $(92.5-91) = 1.5$
Ratio $= 1 : 1.5 \Rightarrow 2 : 3$
Total parts $= 5$, jo 500 gm ke barabar hai. $1 \text{ part} = 100 \text{ gm}$.
Sterling silver $= 2 \text{ parts} = 200 \text{ gm}$.

Takeaway: Mixture ke sawalo me wazan (weight) hamesha percentage differences ke inverse ratio me hota hai.

questions.q: According to a localized census survey, the active demographic base of a metropolitan zone was recorded at 1,02,400 at the end of 2014. Driven by consistent industrialization, this base observed a uniform successive annual growth rate of \(x\%\) for the subsequent three years (2015, 2016, and 2017). The year 2018 witnessed an unprecedented migration surge, causing the population to swell by 35% over the preceding year. However, a sudden pandemic in 2019 triggered a demographic contraction of 10%.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts).

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, language kitni bhi bhayankar ho, structure simple hai. "End of 2019" ki final value (243,000) se hume "End of 2017" tak reverse gear lagana hai. 10% decline ka ulta \(\frac{10}{9}\) aur 35% jump ka ulta \(\frac{20}{27}\) (kyunki 135% = \(\frac{27}{20}\)). Ek baar 2017 ka data mil gaya, toh seedha 2014 wale base se ratio banake Cube Root pel dena hai. Aur jo second part pucha hai (2018-2019 ka effective change), wo directly successive formula \(A + B + \frac{AB}{100}\) se bina population value use kiye nikal jayega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse Gear & Ratio Masterclass.

Mathematically :-

$$ P_{2017} = 243000 \times \frac{10}{9} \times \frac{20}{27} = 200000 $$

$$ \text{Multiplier}^3 = \frac{200000}{102400} = \frac{2000}{1024} = \frac{125}{64} $$

$$ \text{Multiplier} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{125}{64}} = \frac{5}{4} \implies 25\% \text{ (Value of } x) $$

$$ \text{Effective } \% (2018-19) = 35 - 10 - \frac{35 \times 10}{100} = 21.5\% $$

$$ \text{Ratio} = 25 : 21.5 = 250 : 215 = 50 : 43 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic Successive Chain.

Mathematically :-

$$ 102400 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \left(\frac{135}{100}\right) \times \left(\frac{90}{100}\right) = 243000 $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \frac{27}{20} \times \frac{9}{10} = \frac{243000}{102400} $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{2430}{1024} \times \frac{200}{243} = \frac{2000}{1024} $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{125}{64} $$

$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} = \frac{5}{4} \implies x = 25 $$

$$ \text{Net } \%_{2018-19} = \left( \frac{135}{100} \times \frac{90}{100} \right) - 1 = 1.215 - 1 = 21.5\% $$

$$ \text{Req. Ratio} = 25 : 21.5 = 50 : 43 $$

Exam Takeaway: Ninja trick always wins! Examiner ne intentionally 243,000 aur 102,400 aise set kiye hain ki ratio directly 27 aur 9 ke multiple me kate aur end me perfect cube 125/64 bache. Kabhi bhi intermediate exact numbers mat nikalna, seedha fraction ka chain kaato aur answer tik karo!

questions.q: A salesman is allowed $16.66\%$ commission on the total sales made by him and a bonus of $3.33\%$ on the sales over 18000rs. if the total earning of the salesman is $\text{Rs. } 9720$. Find the total sales?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling (Base Shift / Imaginary Increment)]

Pen-Free Observation: Agar salesman ko shuru ke 18000 par bhi bonus milne lagta, toh total sales par flat $20\%$ milta! Us imaginary commission ko jodo aur direct ans nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Agar usko pure par $3.33\%$ bonus milta toh extra kitna kamata?
Extra $= 18000 \times 3.33\% = 18000 \times \frac{1}{30} = 600$.
Toh total imaginary earning hoti: $9720 + 600 = 10320$.
Ab total rate ban gaya $16.66\% + 3.33\% = 20\%$.
$20\%$ (yani $1/5$) $= 10320$.
Total Sales $= 10320 \times 5 = 51600$.

Takeaway: Pieces me tuti hui percent ko jod kar straight line banana (Shift Method) best exam hack hai.

questions.q: Number of females in a city is $22.22\%$ less than the number of male and the percentage of the children among male and female are $25\%$ and $40\%$ respectively. If the number of adults in the city is 76650, then find the number of children in the city?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $22.22\%$ dekhte hi dimaag me $2/9$ aana chahiye. Males ko base 9 maan, toh females 7 hongi. Calculation asaan karne ke liye 900 aur 700 maan le.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): M=900, F=700. Children $25\%$ and $40\%$ hain toh Adults kitne honge? $75\%$ and $60\%$. Adult sum nikal ke real value se equate kar de. 1 unit aate hi children ke total se multiply maar.

Mathematically :-
$M=900, F=700$
$\text{Child M} = 900 \times 0.25 = 225$
$\text{Child F} = 700 \times 0.40 = 280$
$\text{Total Child} = 505$
$\text{Adult} = 1095 \equiv 76650$
$1 \text{ unit} = 70$
$\text{Ans} = 505 \times 70 = 35350$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction ko theek se tod: Adult M nikal aur Adult F nikal. Total adults ki imaginary unit ko 76650 se compare karke unitary method lagana hai.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Adult M} = 900 \times 0.75 = 675$
$\text{Adult F} = 700 \times 0.60 = 420$
$\text{Total Adults} = 1095 \equiv 76650$
$1 \text{ unit} = 70$
$\text{Children} = (900-675) + (700-420) = 505$
$\text{Ans} = 505 \times 70 = 35350$

Exam Takeaway: Jab decimals me percentage aaye toh base humesha aisi unit lo jo fraction ke denominator ka multiple ho (yaha 9).

questions.q: The ticket of an IPL match in Chennai was Rs. 2,500. When the price of the ticket was lowered, the sale (number of tickets) of the tickets was increased by 50%, but the revenue noticed a reduction of 15%. What was the reduced price of the ticket (rounded off to two decimal places)?
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 1. CPR

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, Revenue = Price $\times$ Sale. Sale 1.5 times ho gayi. Revenue $0.85$ reh gaya. Naya Price nikalege toh Seedha Net ko Sale se divide kar de. $\frac{0.85}{1.5} \times 2500$. Cut karega toh $\frac{8500}{6}$ aayega. 1416.66 aayega, direct mark kar!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Multiplier matching.

Mathematically :-
$$ P_1 \times S_1 = R_1 \implies P_2 \times 1.5 S_1 = 0.85 R_1 \\ \frac{P_2}{P_1} \times 1.5 = 0.85 \\ P_2 = P_1 \times \frac{0.85}{1.5} \\ P_2 = 2500 \times \frac{85}{150} = 2500 \times \frac{17}{30} \\ = \frac{4250}{3} = 1416.666... \approx 1416.67 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Taking base values 100.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Let initial Sales} = 100 \implies \text{Rev} = 2500 \times 100 = 250000 \\ \text{New Rev} = 250000 \times 0.85 = 212500 \\ \text{New Sales} = 100 \times 1.5 = 150 \\ \text{New Price} = \frac{\text{New Rev}}{\text{New Sales}} \\ = \frac{212500}{150} = \frac{4250}{3} = 1416.67 $$

Exam Takeaway: CPR equation format works everywhere: Final = Initial $\times$ M1 $\times$ M2.

questions.q: Out of total population of a city, 450 are males. Respective ratio of literate to illiterate females is 5: 2 and their difference is 150. If $28\%$ males are illiterate, then find the percentage of literate population.
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling]

Pen-Free Observation: Female ratio 5:2 hai, inka difference 3 units $= 150$ (so 1 unit $= 50$). Bas isse values direct dimaag me nikali ja sakti hain.Ab isme tum literate female nikal ho chuke hoge ratio ki help se toh total lit \% niaklne ke liye deviation mt lgana isliye niche wala soln best hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Females: Difference $3 \text{ units} = 150 \Rightarrow 1 \text{ unit} = 50$.
Total Females $= 7 \text{ units} = 350$.
Literate Females $= 5 \text{ units} = 250$.
Males: Total $450$ hain. Agar $28\%$ illiterate hain, toh $72\%$ literate honge.
Literate Males $= 72\%$ of $450 = 324$.
Total Literate $= 250 + 324 = 574$.
Total Population $= 450 \text{ (M)} + 350 \text{ (F)} = 800$.
$\text{Literate } \% = \frac{574}{800} \times 100 = \frac{574}{8} = 71.75\%$.
Ekdum straight bat pe aane wali ball thi.

questions.q: A number is decreased by 35%, then increased by 25% and then further increased by 15%. What is the net increase/decrease percentage in the number (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Jab itne ajeeb percentages (35%, 25%, 15%) ek saath aa jayein, toh formula lagane se behter direct fraction chain khelna zyada safe hota hai.



Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, inko decimals me le.
Multiplier banega $= 0.65 \times 1.25 \times 1.15$.
Ab isko dimaag me tod: $0.65 \times \frac{5}{4} = \frac{3.25}{4} = 0.8125$.
Ab 1.15 se karna hai toh: $0.8125 \times (1 + 0.15) = 0.8125 + 0.121875 = 0.934375$.
Total value base 1 se ghir kar lagbhag 0.934 bachi.
Net chnage $= 1 - 0.934375 = 0.0656$. Yani $6.56\%$ ka decrease hai. Nearest integer 7% decrease hoga.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Varna tu apna formula $X+Y+\frac{XY}{100}$ parts me laga le: $-35 + 25 - 8.75 = -18.75\%$. Phir is result ko 15 ke saath merge kar: $-18.75 + 15 - \frac{18.75 \times 15}{100} = -6.5625\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Multiplication ko split kar ke add karna ($X \times (1 + 0.15)$) traditional lamba guna karne se kahin zyada fast hota hai.

Split Multiplication$1.15$ ko $1 + 0.15$ karke add karna fast hota hai.

questions.q: A bucket is filled with water such that the weight of bucket alone is $25\%$ its weight when it is filled with water. Now some of the water is removed from the bucket and now the weight of bucket along with remaining water is $50\%$ of the original total weight. What part of the water was removed from the bucket?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab question fraction ya percentage me answer mang raha ho, real values ka koi kaam nahi. Seedha $100$ assumed base pakad ke nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le poori bhari bucket ka weight $100$ hai. Smart work se khelo babu! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Total}_1 = 100 \implies \text{Bucket} = 25, \text{Water}_1 = 75 \\ \text{Total}_2 = 50\% \text{ of } 100 = 50 \\ \text{Water}_2 = 50 - 25 = 25 \\ \text{Removed} = 75 - 25 = 50 \\ \text{Fraction} = \frac{50}{75} = \frac{2}{3} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations se solve karna hai toh variables lene padenge, jo exam me fasayega. Mathematically :- $$ B = 0.25(B + W_1) \implies 0.75B = 0.25W_1 \implies W_1 = 3B \\ B + W_2 = 0.50(B + W_1) = 0.50(4B) = 2B \implies W_2 = B \\ \text{Removed} = 3B - B = 2B \\ \text{Part} = \frac{2B}{3B} = \frac{2}{3} $$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio values me real numbers mat dhoondo, direct base 100 assume karke bucket ko constant rakho.

questions.q: The income of a company increases by x% per year. If its income is 31,25,000 in the year 2019, and the income in 2017 was 20,00,000, then what is the value of x?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: 2 saal ka time gap hai matlab Final/Initial ka ratio ka square root nikalna padega. 3125 aur 2000 me 125 ka common factor saaf dikh raha hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Final aur Initial ka ratio nikal:
$$ \frac{3125000}{2000000} = \frac{3125}{2000} = \frac{25}{16} $$
Do saal ka matter hai toh seedha root le de: $\sqrt{\frac{25}{16}} = \frac{5}{4}$. $\frac{5}{4}$ ka seedha sa matlab hai 1 part ka increment 4 par, jo ki exactly $25\%$ hota hai. Pen free uda diya!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic compound interest wala hisaab hai. $A = P(1 + \frac{R}{100})^T$. Yahan $A=3125$, $P=2000$, $T=2$ rakh ke $R=25$ nikal sakta hai.

Exam Takeaway: Kabhi bhi bade numbers ka root mat le. Hamesha ratio ko lowest form me kaat ke fir root apply kar.

Math ConceptTime Formula
Compound GrowthRate = $(Final/Initial)^{\frac{1}{t}} - 1$.

questions.q: The population of a town decreases by x% in the year 2020 and increases by 2x% in the year 2021. If the population of the city at the end of 2019 is 45000 and that of the city at the end of 2021 is 49536, then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, base 45000 hai aur final 49536 hai. Total change thoda sa positive hai, lagbhag 10%. Direct net percentage change nikal aur successive net-effect rule me option satisfy karwa.

Method 1 (Ultra Ninja Technique): Net percentage growth nikal aur successive percentage ka net-effect formula (A + B + AB/100) mind me set kar jahan A = -x aur B = +2x. Phir direct option se satisfy karwa.
Mathematically :-
$$ \frac{49536 - 45000}{450} = \frac{4536}{450} = 10.08\% $$
$$ -x + 2x - \frac{x \times 2x}{100} = 10.08\% $$
$$ x - \frac{2x^2}{100} \approx 10\% $$
$$ 14 - \frac{2(14)^2}{100} = 14 - \frac{392}{100} = 14 - 3.92 = 10.08\% $$

Method 2 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Option 14\% utha aur direct fraction multipliers laga ke digital sum ya last digits verify kar le.
Mathematically :-
$$ 45000 \times \left(1 - \frac{14}{100}\right) \times \left(1 + \frac{28}{100}\right) $$
$$ 45000 \times 0.86 \times 1.28 $$
$$ 45 \times 86 \times 12.8 = 49536 $$

Method 3 (Concept Builder): Pura basic equation set karke quadratic banani padegi jo time legi.
Mathematically :-
$$ 45000 \left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) \left(1 + \frac{2x}{100}\right) = 49536 $$
$$ \left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) \left(1 + \frac{2x}{100}\right) = \frac{49536}{45000} $$
$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} - \frac{2x^2}{10000} = 1.1008 $$
$$ \frac{x}{100} - \frac{2x^2}{10000} = 0.1008 $$
$$ x = 14 $$

Exam Takeaway: Ultra Ninja Technique sabse deadly hai kyunki isme actual calculation 4536/450 nikalte hi option se seedha dikh jata hai. Exam me hamesha net change percentage se approach kar.

questions.q: In a school, $50\%$ of the students play cricket, $40\%$ of the students play football and the number of students who play both games is 420. The number of students who play neither cricket nor football is $45\%$. Find the total number of students in the school.
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, $45\%$ kuch nahi khelte, matlab $55\%$ kuch toh khelte hain. Venn diagram ka union $55\%$ hai. Cricket ($50\%$) + Football ($40\%$) = $90\%$. Intersection kya hoga? $90\% - 55\% = 35\%$. Ab $35\%$ ki value 420 di hai. $1\% = 12$, toh $100\% = 1200$. Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi!

Method 1 (Concept Builder):

Mathematically :-

$$ n(C \cup F) = 100\% - 45\% = 55\% \\ n(C \cap F) = n(C) + n(F) - n(C \cup F) \\ n(C \cap F) = 50\% + 40\% - 55\% = 35\% \\ 35\% \rightarrow 420 \\ 1\% \rightarrow 12 \\ 100\% \rightarrow 1200 $$

Exam Takeaway: Seedha divisibility check kar, 12 ka multiple option me ek hi hai. Mental Venn diagram hi best approach hai exam ke liye!

questions.q: $62.5\%$ of a number exceeds $25\%$ of the same number by 15. What is the number? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - 31/07/2025 - SHIFT 3)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sidha difference dikh raha hai. $62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$. Aur $37.5\%$ ki standard fraction $3/8$ hoti hai. Dimaag me set rakh isko!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $3/8$ part ki value 15 hai. 3 part 15 hain toh 1 part 5 hoga. Pura number 8 part hai, toh $8 \times 5 = 40$. Seconds ka game hai ye.

Mathematically :-
$62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$
$37.5\% = \frac{3}{8}$
$\frac{3}{8} \equiv 15 \implies 1 \equiv 5$
$\text{Num} = 8 \times 5 = 40$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation $0.625x - 0.25x = 15$ likh ke solve kar le. Lekin decimals exam me rulate hain, hamesha fractions use kar.

Mathematically :-
$0.625x - 0.25x = 15$
$0.375x = 15$
$x = \frac{15}{0.375} = 40$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage difference agar standard fraction ho toh seedha numerator-denominator ka khel khel.

questions.q: During a division, Pranjal mistakenly took as the dividend a number that was $10\%$ more than the original dividend. He also mistakenly took as the divisor a number that was $25\%$ more than the original divisor. If the correct quotient of the original division problem was 25 and the remainder was 0, what was the quotient that Pranjal obtained, assuming his calculations had no error?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Dividend numerator hai aur Divisor denominator. Dono me percentage change unka multiplier change kar dega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dividend $10\%$ badha yani $1.1$ guna ho gaya. Divisor $25\%$ badha yani $1.25$ guna ho gaya. Naya Quotient banega Purana Quotient $\times \frac{1.1}{1.25}$. Pura Quotient $25$ diya hai. Toh $25 \times \frac{110}{125} = 25 \times \frac{22}{25} = 22$. Bhai isme kuch tha hi nahi, seedha multiplication tha!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formally likhega toh: $Q = \frac{D}{d}$. Mistaken $Q' = \frac{1.1D}{1.25d} = \frac{1.1}{1.25} \times Q = \frac{1.1}{1.25} \times 25 = 22$.

Exam Takeaway: Fraction me upar neeche alag alag percentage lagna aam baat hai, multipliers ka concept clear rakho.

questions.q: $\frac{11}{5}$ of a number A is $22\%$ of a number B. The number B is equal to $2.5\%$ of a third number C. If the value of C is 5500, then the sum of $80\%$ of A and $40\%$ of B is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, C ki value aakhiri me di hai, toh peeche se attack karna start kar, aage se jaayega toh ulajh jayega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse chalte hain! $C = 5500$. B uska $2.5\%$ hai. $2.5\%$ nikalne ke liye $\frac{1}{40}$ kar de, $5500 / 40 = 137.5$. Ab A aur B ka relation dekh: $\frac{11}{5} A = \frac{22}{100} B$. Yani $2.2A = 0.22B$, toh $A = 0.1B$. Toh A aagaya $13.75$. Ab pucha kya hai? $80\%$ of A ($11$) aur $40\%$ of B ($55$) ka sum. $11 + 55 = 66$. Khatak!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions me khelna hai toh: A ka $\frac{11}{5} = B \times \frac{11}{50} \implies A = \frac{B}{10}$. Phir $B = 5500 \times \frac{1}{40}$. Raste wahi hain bas decimals se dar lagta ho toh fractions best hain.

questions.q: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B and C. The candidate secured 75% marks in Paper A, 80% marks in Paper B, and 60% marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B and C were 40%, 50% and 10%, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all three papers were taken together.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 3. JSM/Deviation

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, weights ka ratio 4:5:1 hai. Base mark $75\%$ maan le. A me deviation 0. B me $+5\%$ ka deviation hai 5 weights pe ($+25$). C me $-15\%$ ka deviation hai 1 weight pe ($-15$). Net deviation = $+10$. Isko total 10 weights me baant de. $+1\%$ aayega. $75 + 1 = 76\%$. Aman Bhaiya ka JSM zindabad!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
JSM application on weights.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weights} = 4 : 5 : 1 \quad (Total = 10) \\ \text{Scores} = 75\%, 80\%, 60\% \\ \text{Assume Base} = 75\% \\ \text{Deviations} = 0\%, +5\%, -15\% \\ \text{Net Deviation} = (4 \times 0) + (5 \times 5) + (1 \times -15) = +25 - 15 = +10 \\ \text{Average Change} = \frac{+10}{10} = +1\% \\ \text{Final} = 75\% + 1\% = 76\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Standard weighted average.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weighted Avg} = \frac{W_1 S_1 + W_2 S_2 + W_3 S_3}{W_1 + W_2 + W_3} \\ = \frac{4(75) + 5(80) + 1(60)}{10} \\ = \frac{300 + 400 + 60}{10} = \frac{760}{10} = 76\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Weighted average ke questions bas JSM practice check karte hain. Calculation easy thi isliye simple method bhi fast hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ulta chalna shuru kar! Final value $1,16,160$ tab mili jab teesre ghante me $10\%$ ka increment (yaani $\frac{11}{10}$ multiplier) lag chuka tha. Toh isko wapas reverse karke second hour ke end ki value nikal le.

Mathematically :-
$$11 \rightarrow 1,16,160$$
$$10 \rightarrow 1,16,160 \times \frac{10}{11} = 1,05,600$$
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,32,000$$
$$\text{Decrease} = \frac{1,32,000 - 1,05,600}{1,32,000} \times 100\% = 20\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Seedha successive ka formula laga, aur unknown multiplier ko $t$ maan le. Ek line ki equation me sab set ho jayega.

Mathematically :-
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} \times t \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,16,160$$
$$1,45,200 \times t = 1,16,160$$
$$t = \frac{1,16,160}{1,45,200} = \frac{4}{5}$$
$$1 - \frac{4}{5} = \frac{1}{5} = 20\% \text{ drop}$$

questions.q: P's income is 150 percent of Q's income and P's expenditure is 60 percent of Q's expenditure. If Q saves 20 percent of his income, then how much percentage does P save of his own income?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Options integers me hain, toh calculation easy karne ke liye base ko 300 aur 200 maan le taaki zeroes kat jayein aur decimal ka lafda na rahe.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Q ki income 200 maan. Usne 20\% bachaya, yani 40 bachaya, toh kharcha hua 160. P ka kharcha Q ke kharche (160) ka 60\% hai, matlab $160 \times 0.6 = 96$. P ki income 300 thi, usme se 96 udaya toh bacha 204. Seedha percentage nikal: $\frac{204}{300} \times 100 = 68\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar tu x aur y variables banayega, toh linear equations fasa dengi. Ratio base-shifting laga. $Income - Expenditure = Savings$ ka base fraction hi set kar le. Bina x-y ke values assume karna hi real CGL preparation hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Base values aisi assume kar jisme zeroes jyada hon. Percentage calculations me decimals se bachna hi speed badhata hai.

Calculation StepValue
A. Q's Expenditure1. $200 - 40 = 160$
B. P's Expenditure2. $160 \times 0.60 = 96$
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Ratio Base Shifting)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Yahan hume do alag ratios (Income aur Expenditure) ko ek same scale par laana hai bina variables (x, y) maane. Is ninja technique ko 'Make it Equal and Scale' kehte hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):
Humare paas do alag ratios hain:
Income (I) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 2
Expenditure (E) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 5

Condition: Q saves 20% of his income. Yani Q ka kharcha (E) uski income ka 80% hai. Toh Q ke liye: I : E = 100 : 80 = 5 : 4.
Bas ab hume Q ki values ko 5 : 4 ke ratio me set karna hai.

Step 1: Q ko pehle barabar (Equal) kar le.
Income ko 5 se aur Expenditure ko 2 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ 15 : 10
E $\rightarrow$ 6 : 10

Step 2: Ab Q ko 5 : 4 ke scale par set kar de.
I ko 5 se, E ko 4 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ (15 $\times$ 5) : (10 $\times$ 5) $\rightarrow$ 75 : 50
E $\rightarrow$ (6 $\times$ 4) : (10 $\times$ 4) $\rightarrow$ 24 : 40

Step 3: Magic Happens!
Check kar, Q ki income 50 hai aur kharcha 40 (jo ki 80% hai). Condition set!
Ab P ka data utha:
P Income = 75, P Expenditure = 24 $\rightarrow$ Savings = 75 - 24 = 51.
Percentage Saving = $\frac{51}{75} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 17 \times 4 = 68\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Q ki 5 units (E) = 80% of Q's Income (2 units of I).
So, $5E = \frac{4}{5} \times 2I \implies 5E = \frac{8}{5} I \implies 1E = \frac{8}{25} I$.
P ka Kharcha = $3E = 3 \times \frac{8}{25} I = \frac{24}{25} I$.
P ki Income = $3I$. P ki Bachat = $3I - \frac{24}{25}I = \frac{51}{25}I$.
Savings % = $\frac{\frac{51}{25}I}{3I} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 68\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is ultimate! Jab bhi do ratios ko aapas me fraction se link karna ho, toh LCM le kar Equal kar le, phir required ratio se Scale kar de. Zero variable, full marks!

questions.q: If an equal number of social media accounts are created on each day, find the approximate percentage of the accounts whose creation anniversary will fall on 29th February. (Assume accounts created throughout the 20th century and no account deletions).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: 20th century me $1901$ se $2000$ tak poore $100$ saal hote hain. $2000$ ek leap year hai, toh exactly 25 leap years aayenge. Total din nikal kar 25 ka fraction check karo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Total days denominator me lo aur leap days numerator me. Approximation se $1461$ din me ek 29 Feb aati hai.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Total Days} = (75 \times 365) + (25 \times 366) = 36525 \\ \text{29th Feb Occurrences} = 25 \\ \% = \frac{25}{36525} \times 100 \\ = \frac{100}{1461} \approx 0.0684 \% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): 400 saal ka general block bhi laga sakte ho but century fixed hai toh exact calculation behtar hai.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Cycle of 4 years} = (3 \times 365) + 366 = 1461 \text{ days} \\ \text{In 20th century (1901-2000), 2000 is leap.} \\ \text{Total complete 4-year cycles} = 25 \\ \text{Number of 29 Feb} = 25 \times 1 = 25 \\ \text{Percentage} = \frac{25}{25 \times 1461} \times 100 = \frac{100}{1461} \% = 0.0684 \% $$

Exam Takeaway: Calendar based percentage probability me 4 saal ka block (1461 days) hamesha memory me rakho. Shortcut fraction sidha $1/1461$ hota hai if century ends with a leap year.

The ratio of the people who like only tea and the people who like only coffee are 3 : 4 respectively, the number of people who like both drinks is $6.25\%$ of total. If $50\%$ of the people in the cafe are like to drink something out of total 80 people, then find the total number of people in the cafe house who drink only tea.
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling (Venn Diagram)]

Pen-Free Observation: 'Drink something' wale $50\%$ hain matlab baki $50\%$ kuch nahi peete unka koi role hi nahi hai set theory me. Seedha un $40$ logo pe game khelo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Total people $= 80$.
Peene wale (Union) $= 50\%$ of $80 = 40$.
Dono peene wale (Intersection) $= 6.25\%$ (yani $1/16$) of $80 = 5$.
Only Tea + Only Coffee $= \text{Union} - \text{Both} = 40 - 5 = 35$.
Ratio Only Tea : Only Coffee $= 3:4$ (Total 7 units).
$7 \text{ units} = 35 \Rightarrow 1 \text{ unit} = 5$.
Only Tea $= 3 \text{ units} = 15$.

Takeaway: Kuch data sirf distract karne ke liye hota hai, Venn Diagram ki core formula property $\text{Union} = A + B - \text{Intersection}$ se banta hai.

Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts).

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, language kitni bhi bhayankar ho, structure simple hai. "End of 2019" ki final value (243,000) se hume "End of 2017" tak reverse gear lagana hai. 10% decline ka ulta \(\frac{10}{9}\) aur 35% jump ka ulta \(\frac{20}{27}\) (kyunki 135% = \(\frac{27}{20}\)). Ek baar 2017 ka data mil gaya, toh seedha 2014 wale base se ratio banake Cube Root pel dena hai. Aur jo second part pucha hai (2018-2019 ka effective change), wo directly successive formula \(A + B + \frac{AB}{100}\) se bina population value use kiye nikal jayega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse Gear & Ratio Masterclass.

Mathematically :-

$$ P_{2017} = 243000 \times \frac{10}{9} \times \frac{20}{27} = 200000 $$

$$ \text{Multiplier}^3 = \frac{200000}{102400} = \frac{2000}{1024} = \frac{125}{64} $$

$$ \text{Multiplier} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{125}{64}} = \frac{5}{4} \implies 25\% \text{ (Value of } x) $$

$$ \text{Effective } \% (2018-19) = 35 - 10 - \frac{35 \times 10}{100} = 21.5\% $$

$$ \text{Ratio} = 25 : 21.5 = 250 : 215 = 50 : 43 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic Successive Chain.

Mathematically :-

$$ 102400 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \left(\frac{135}{100}\right) \times \left(\frac{90}{100}\right) = 243000 $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \frac{27}{20} \times \frac{9}{10} = \frac{243000}{102400} $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{2430}{1024} \times \frac{200}{243} = \frac{2000}{1024} $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{125}{64} $$

$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} = \frac{5}{4} \implies x = 25 $$

$$ \text{Net } \%_{2018-19} = \left( \frac{135}{100} \times \frac{90}{100} \right) - 1 = 1.215 - 1 = 21.5\% $$

$$ \text{Req. Ratio} = 25 : 21.5 = 50 : 43 $$

Exam Takeaway: Ninja trick always wins! Examiner ne intentionally 243,000 aur 102,400 aise set kiye hain ki ratio directly 27 aur 9 ke multiple me kate aur end me perfect cube 125/64 bache. Kabhi bhi intermediate exact numbers mat nikalna, seedha fraction ka chain kaato aur answer tik karo!

questions_hin.q_hi: The population of a town decreases by x% in the year 2020 and increases by 2x% in the year 2021. If the population of the city at the end of 2019 is 45000 and that of the city at the end of 2021 is 49536, then find the value of x.

Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, base 45000 hai aur final 49536 hai. Total change thoda sa positive hai, lagbhag 10%. Direct net percentage change nikal aur successive net-effect rule me option satisfy karwa.

Method 1 (Ultra Ninja Technique): Net percentage growth nikal aur successive percentage ka net-effect formula (A + B + AB/100) mind me set kar jahan A = -x aur B = +2x. Phir direct option se satisfy karwa.
Mathematically :-
$$ \frac{49536 - 45000}{450} = \frac{4536}{450} = 10.08\% $$
$$ -x + 2x - \frac{x \times 2x}{100} = 10.08\% $$
$$ x - \frac{2x^2}{100} \approx 10\% $$
$$ 14 - \frac{2(14)^2}{100} = 14 - \frac{392}{100} = 14 - 3.92 = 10.08\% $$

Method 2 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Option 14\% utha aur direct fraction multipliers laga ke digital sum ya last digits verify kar le.
Mathematically :-
$$ 45000 \times \left(1 - \frac{14}{100}\right) \times \left(1 + \frac{28}{100}\right) $$
$$ 45000 \times 0.86 \times 1.28 $$
$$ 45 \times 86 \times 12.8 = 49536 $$

Method 3 (Concept Builder): Pura basic equation set karke quadratic banani padegi jo time legi.
Mathematically :-
$$ 45000 \left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) \left(1 + \frac{2x}{100}\right) = 49536 $$
$$ \left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) \left(1 + \frac{2x}{100}\right) = \frac{49536}{45000} $$
$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} - \frac{2x^2}{10000} = 1.1008 $$
$$ \frac{x}{100} - \frac{2x^2}{10000} = 0.1008 $$
$$ x = 14 $$

Exam Takeaway: Ultra Ninja Technique sabse deadly hai kyunki isme actual calculation 4536/450 nikalte hi option se seedha dikh jata hai. Exam me hamesha net change percentage se approach kar.

Mathematically :-

Exam Takeaway: Seedha divisibility check kar, 12 ka multiple option me ek hi hai. Mental Venn diagram hi best approach hai exam ke liye!

questions_hin.q_hi: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B and C. The candidate secured 75% marks in Paper A, 80% marks in Paper B, and 60% marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B and C were 40%, 50% and 10%, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all three papers were taken together.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 3. JSM/Deviation

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, weights ka ratio 4:5:1 hai. Base mark $75\%$ maan le. A me deviation 0. B me $+5\%$ ka deviation hai 5 weights pe ($+25$). C me $-15\%$ ka deviation hai 1 weight pe ($-15$). Net deviation = $+10$. Isko total 10 weights me baant de. $+1\%$ aayega. $75 + 1 = 76\%$. Aman Bhaiya ka JSM zindabad!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
JSM application on weights.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weights} = 4 : 5 : 1 \quad (Total = 10) \\ \text{Scores} = 75\%, 80\%, 60\% \\ \text{Assume Base} = 75\% \\ \text{Deviations} = 0\%, +5\%, -15\% \\ \text{Net Deviation} = (4 \times 0) + (5 \times 5) + (1 \times -15) = +25 - 15 = +10 \\ \text{Average Change} = \frac{+10}{10} = +1\% \\ \text{Final} = 75\% + 1\% = 76\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Standard weighted average.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weighted Avg} = \frac{W_1 S_1 + W_2 S_2 + W_3 S_3}{W_1 + W_2 + W_3} \\ = \frac{4(75) + 5(80) + 1(60)}{10} \\ = \frac{300 + 400 + 60}{10} = \frac{760}{10} = 76\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Weighted average ke questions bas JSM practice check karte hain. Calculation easy thi isliye simple method bhi fast hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: The number of bacteria in a petri dish was 1,20,000. It increased by 10% in the first hour and changed by x in the second hour. In the third hour, it increases by 10%. If the current number is 1,16,160, then determine the change in population in the second hour.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dhyan se dekh. Pehle aur teesre ghante me $10\%$ ka increment hai, par final population $1,20,000$ se gir kar $1,16,160$ ho gayi hai. Iska seedha matlab hai ki beech me ek bhayankar drop aaya hoga. Reverse calculation marna yaha sabse fast hack hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ulta chalna shuru kar! Final value $1,16,160$ tab mili jab teesre ghante me $10\%$ ka increment (yaani $\frac{11}{10}$ multiplier) lag chuka tha. Toh isko wapas reverse karke second hour ke end ki value nikal le.

Mathematically :-
$$11 \rightarrow 1,16,160$$
$$10 \rightarrow 1,16,160 \times \frac{10}{11} = 1,05,600$$
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,32,000$$
$$\text{Decrease} = \frac{1,32,000 - 1,05,600}{1,32,000} \times 100\% = 20\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Seedha successive ka formula laga, aur unknown multiplier ko $t$ maan le. Ek line ki equation me sab set ho jayega.

Mathematically :-
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} \times t \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,16,160$$
$$1,45,200 \times t = 1,16,160$$
$$t = \frac{1,16,160}{1,45,200} = \frac{4}{5}$$
$$1 - \frac{4}{5} = \frac{1}{5} = 20\% \text{ drop}$$

questions_hin.q_hi: P's income is 150 percent of Q's income and P's expenditure is 60 percent of Q's expenditure. If Q saves 20 percent of his income, then how much percentage does P save of his own income?
questions_hin.s_hi:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Options integers me hain, toh calculation easy karne ke liye base ko 300 aur 200 maan le taaki zeroes kat jayein aur decimal ka lafda na rahe.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Q ki income 200 maan. Usne 20\% bachaya, yani 40 bachaya, toh kharcha hua 160. P ka kharcha Q ke kharche (160) ka 60\% hai, matlab $160 \times 0.6 = 96$. P ki income 300 thi, usme se 96 udaya toh bacha 204. Seedha percentage nikal: $\frac{204}{300} \times 100 = 68\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar tu x aur y variables banayega, toh linear equations fasa dengi. Ratio base-shifting laga. $Income - Expenditure = Savings$ ka base fraction hi set kar le. Bina x-y ke values assume karna hi real CGL preparation hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Base values aisi assume kar jisme zeroes jyada hon. Percentage calculations me decimals se bachna hi speed badhata hai.

Calculation StepValue
A. Q's Expenditure1. $200 - 40 = 160$
B. P's Expenditure2. $160 \times 0.60 = 96$
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Ratio Base Shifting)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Yahan hume do alag ratios (Income aur Expenditure) ko ek same scale par laana hai bina variables (x, y) maane. Is ninja technique ko 'Make it Equal and Scale' kehte hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):
Humare paas do alag ratios hain:
Income (I) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 2
Expenditure (E) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 5

Condition: Q saves 20% of his income. Yani Q ka kharcha (E) uski income ka 80% hai. Toh Q ke liye: I : E = 100 : 80 = 5 : 4.
Bas ab hume Q ki values ko 5 : 4 ke ratio me set karna hai.

Step 1: Q ko pehle barabar (Equal) kar le.
Income ko 5 se aur Expenditure ko 2 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ 15 : 10
E $\rightarrow$ 6 : 10

Step 2: Ab Q ko 5 : 4 ke scale par set kar de.
I ko 5 se, E ko 4 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ (15 $\times$ 5) : (10 $\times$ 5) $\rightarrow$ 75 : 50
E $\rightarrow$ (6 $\times$ 4) : (10 $\times$ 4) $\rightarrow$ 24 : 40

Step 3: Magic Happens!
Check kar, Q ki income 50 hai aur kharcha 40 (jo ki 80% hai). Condition set!
Ab P ka data utha:
P Income = 75, P Expenditure = 24 $\rightarrow$ Savings = 75 - 24 = 51.
Percentage Saving = $\frac{51}{75} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 17 \times 4 = 68\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Q ki 5 units (E) = 80% of Q's Income (2 units of I).
So, $5E = \frac{4}{5} \times 2I \implies 5E = \frac{8}{5} I \implies 1E = \frac{8}{25} I$.
P ka Kharcha = $3E = 3 \times \frac{8}{25} I = \frac{24}{25} I$.
P ki Income = $3I$. P ki Bachat = $3I - \frac{24}{25}I = \frac{51}{25}I$.
Savings % = $\frac{\frac{51}{25}I}{3I} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 68\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is ultimate! Jab bhi do ratios ko aapas me fraction se link karna ho, toh LCM le kar Equal kar le, phir required ratio se Scale kar de. Zero variable, full marks!

questions_hin.q_hi: If an equal number of social media accounts are created on each day, find the approximate percentage of the accounts whose creation anniversary will fall on 29th February. (Assume accounts created throughout the 20th century and no account deletions).
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: 20th century me $1901$ se $2000$ tak poore $100$ saal hote hain. $2000$ ek leap year hai, toh exactly 25 leap years aayenge. Total din nikal kar 25 ka fraction check karo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Total days denominator me lo aur leap days numerator me. Approximation se $1461$ din me ek 29 Feb aati hai.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Total Days} = (75 \times 365) + (25 \times 366) = 36525 \\ \text{29th Feb Occurrences} = 25 \\ \% = \frac{25}{36525} \times 100 \\ = \frac{100}{1461} \approx 0.0684 \% $$

questions_hin.q_hi: In a cafe house there are some people who like to drink coffee and tea while some do not drink anything. The ratio of the people who like only tea and the people who like only coffee are 3 : 4 respectively, the number of people who like both drinks is $6.25\%$ of total. If $50\%$ of the people in the cafe are like to drink something out of total 80 people, then find the total number of people in the cafe house who drink only tea.
questions_hin.s_hi:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling (Venn Diagram)]

Pen-Free Observation: 'Drink something' wale $50\%$ hain matlab baki $50\%$ kuch nahi peete unka koi role hi nahi hai set theory me. Seedha un $40$ logo pe game khelo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Total people $= 80$.
Peene wale (Union) $= 50\%$ of $80 = 40$.
Dono peene wale (Intersection) $= 6.25\%$ (yani $1/16$) of $80 = 5$.
Only Tea + Only Coffee $= \text{Union} - \text{Both} = 40 - 5 = 35$.
Ratio Only Tea : Only Coffee $= 3:4$ (Total 7 units).
$7 \text{ units} = 35 \Rightarrow 1 \text{ unit} = 5$.
Only Tea $= 3 \text{ units} = 15$.

Takeaway: Kuch data sirf distract karne ke liye hota hai, Venn Diagram ki core formula property $\text{Union} = A + B - \text{Intersection}$ se banta hai.
